root_cause: KGP2.4.20 disables all default KMP Maven publications when HostManager.hostIsSupported is false and the project declares any KotlinNativeTarget. Kotlin/Native supports Linux x64 as a producer, not Linux arm64. applyTargets declares iosArm64 and iosSimulatorArm64; desktop-only staging selects tasks but does not remove targets. Thus absence of root and desktop tasks precedes consumer resolution.
scope: Additional Linux-arm64 producer/CI gate only; zero native consumer tests, no dependency/ABI/legal/release certificate
